proposal.reason: Primary change is in the IB network backend (net_ib): connection handshake/state machine redesign, QP RTR/RTS metadata exchange, ECE negotiation, FLID/GID routing selection, TC/SL/FIFO_TC QoS behavior, and per-device MR registration cache/cancel cleanup. `gin` is also needed because GIN-specific IB paths (GIN connect/accept/close and troce adapter wiring) were substantively updated to match the new net_ib connection and cancellation semantics.
